note: M3, the plan's unspent anchored machine job (art plan batch M), run in the redo pass after art review 2, 2026-10-30. Overrides m2_machines.json's b_separator by name. One create_1_direction_object job, 10 generations: no size (the 32x32 anchors set it, 64 candidates), view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name m3_machines, style_images = art/ref/anchors_m2/style_images.json (M2's 8 family anchors: b_miner, b_foundry, b_press, b_spore_filter, b_cutter, b_attuner, b_spore_collector, b_overcharger). PixelLab review object 886f5b69-10a5-4332-b1f1-97c93c5cece8. All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/m3/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot map in _slots); every frame came back 100% Apollo with no partial alpha. The one pick was promoted with select_object_frames (tag m3_machines) and saved as art/raw/m3/b_separator.png, byte-identical to frame 10. Why: art review 2 found b_separator had the same top-view silhouette as b_washer and b_spore_filter (three round copper tubs told apart only by fill colour), and STYLE asks every 2x2 machine for a central shape no other machine shares (here, the tank pair). _light is [x, y, w, h] in final 32 x 32 sprite pixels (the art sits at x 1, y 2 in both the raw frame and the sprite).
_prompt: description: factory machine sprite in high top-down 3/4 view, flat top and a thin south face, square base filling the frame, selective dark outline, lit from upper left, no ground shadow. Every slot has its own wording (M2's lesson: repeated lines return near-copies).

_slots.0-15 separator: the art director's line 'factory machine in high top-down 3/4 view: two tall upright glass tanks side by side on a brass frame, amber resin left, deep blue right, a copper pipe between, plain south face' (slot 0 verbatim) reworded 15 ways: twin cylinders, round brass lids, silos, settling tanks, vats with a gap, a brass cradle or rack, steel lids with a valve wheel, corner posts, pale aqua glints
_slots.16-27 x_l1_minecart: old rusted empty minecart on a short rail, umber and rust-brown, soft dark brown outline, no black, no grey steel (12 wordings)
_slots.28-39 x_l0_crate_stack: low stack of weathered wooden crates, dull brown planks, soft brown outline, no black outline, unpainted (12 wordings)
_slots.40-51 b_generator: square combustion generator, dark iron drum, round smokestack at a back corner, copper-orange pipes, a small glow on the top surface only, plain dark iron south face (12 wordings)
_slots.52-63 b_stabilizer: square stabilizer, brass frame around a glass containment chamber of pale cyan light, amber insulation bands or pads, plain brass south face (12 wordings)

_rejected.b_separator: 2: a brass cabinet with two fluid windows on its south face (the M2 16/19 failure); 3, 15: two thin tubes on stands, 61-72% fill, read as lab glassware; 6: two floating capsules, no base; 9, 12: round-bottom flasks and potion bottles in a rack; 13: pale aqua steel lids and rims (40 px #a4dddb, the Alien light) and a valve wheel, busy; 14: a brass birdcage around the tanks, busy; 7: white milk-glass domes read as two light bulbs; 0, 4, 8, 11: good tank pairs, but pipes arching over the top (0, 4, 8) or glowing bodies (11) make them busier than 10; 5: the right tank is #172038 navy and sinks into a dark floor; 1: glowing cyan tubes (the Crystal accent)
_rejected.x_l1_minecart: 16-27 are all drawn isometric (diagonal rails, rhombus tubs), a different projection from the game's orthographic 3/4 view, and keep a #090a14 outline; the free recolour of the M1 cart (art/edits/redo/edits.json) keeps the projection and reads as rusted decor
_rejected.x_l0_crate_stack: 28-39 are isometric cubes with 79-117 px of #090a14 outline (the loudness review 2 complained about); the free recolour of the M1 stack has none
_rejected.b_generator: not in the redo list, so the M2 pick stays; for a later pass: 43 (glowing grate on the top face, smokestack, copper pipe) and 47 (drum with a glowing top) put the fire on top, but both are isometric boxes; 40, 41, 49, 50, 51 put the fire or vents on the south face; 48 is three small drums
_rejected.b_stabilizer: the free chamber recolour of the M2 pick (art/edits/redo/edits.json) wins: 52, 57, 59, 61 are isometric cubes and prisms; 53 is a plain top view with no south face and a #a4dddb (Alien) glass fill; 54 a side-view dome; 55, 62 put a glass window or porthole on the south face; 56, 60, 63 round glass tubs, the Chemistry round-tub silhouette again; 58 a flat glass box

_spend: 10 generations (one create_1_direction_object job, review object 886f5b69-10a5-4332-b1f1-97c93c5cece8): account generations_used 3,890.10 before the call, 3,900.10 after. The $2.00 credit was not touched. get_object, select_object_frames and the local review were free.

sprites.name: b_separator
sprites.note: Chemistry: a tank pair, two tall glass settling tanks on a brown base plate, amber resin on the left and deep blue fluid on the right, copper caps seen from above, hopper bottoms with legs, a 2 px gap between the tanks so the floor shows through: no other machine has this silhouette, and it no longer reads as a third round tub next to b_washer and b_spore_filter. Glass glints #a4dddb (2 px) / #73bed3. _light is the top of the amber resin. Body 30x30.
